libraries.name: jQuery
libraries.note: Versions before 3.5.0 have known XSS issues (CVE-2020-11022, CVE-2020-11023).

libraries.name: Bootstrap
libraries.note: Older 3.x/4.x versions have a known XSS issue (CVE-2019-8331).

libraries.name: AngularJS
libraries.note: AngularJS 1.x reached end of life on 31 Dec 2021 and no longer gets security fixes.

libraries.name: lodash
libraries.note: Versions before 4.17.21 have known prototype pollution and command injection issues (CVE-2020-8203, CVE-2021-23337).

libraries.name: Moment.js
libraries.note: Versions before 2.29.4 have a ReDoS issue (CVE-2022-31129).

saq.hosted: Redirect or hosted payment page: card data never touches the merchant site (typically PCI SAQ A).
saq.api-hosted: Gateway iframe or SDK on the merchant page: reduced scope, typically SAQ A or A-EP depending on implementation.
saq.self-hosted: Card data handled by the merchant's own page and servers: largest PCI scope (typically SAQ D).
saq.off-website: Payment is completed outside this page, so the page itself can't be directly assessed.
